title: Workspace · forge manifest
description: A forge (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps…) as data: each workspace operation as argv of the forge CLI, how to read its output, its issue states, the integration that governs its CLI, its pipeline and its examples. Adding a forge is adding a manifest (ADR 0013). Validated by scripts/schema_check.py; `workspace.py check` adds what a schema cannot say (every operation classified by its integration, the examples, a dispatch end to end).

verified.description: When and against which CLI version the commands were checked.

cli.description: The executable every operation starts with.

integration.description: The integration (plantillas/integraciones/<id>.json) that classifies this CLI for the brakes.

issuePattern.description: What counts as an issue reference in a commit message (`tracker.issuePattern`).

closes.description: How a PR or commit closes an issue in this forge.

childBody.description: The child issue body: always names the parent.

wiki.description: The wiki git remote; `{repo}`, `{owner}`, `{project}` are replaced.

repoParts.description: Parts of a repo name: 2 (`owner/repo`) or 3 (`org/project/repo`, Azure).

lineBreak.description: When an issue body is HTML (Azure), the line break written in place of `\n`.

issueTemplate.description: Where the forge reads an issue template from, and the header it needs. `null`: the forge has none.

runner.description: This file runs a scheduled control: its config key gets this path as `runner`.

output.description: How to read what an operation printed: the first group of a regex, or a dotted JSON path.

states.description: The forge's raw issue state → the workspace's.

simulated.description: What the simulated forge prints for an operation, in the same shape as the real CLI.

classes.description: The class each operation has for the brakes; `check` requires the integration to classify it the same.

setup.description: What a human does once, outside the agent.

template.description: argv; a sub-list is an optional group. `null`: the forge does not need this operation.
